If a formula is missing or incomplete in the passages, never reconstruct it from
memory or describe one summation term as the entire formula. Keep a complete formula's
denominator, powers and conditions if explaining it is actually required.

Yes, they do.

Their primary corpus is the Japanese-English (Ja-En) ASPEC data set [2], but they also apply their method to the WMT data set for English-German (En-De), using news-test2014 as a development set and news-test2015 and news-test2016 as test sets [13].
